name: MCP TypeScript Template
description: A production-grade TypeScript template for building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with declarative tools/resources, authentication, storage abstraction, and support for both local and edge deployment. Provides example echo tools and resources to demonstrate MCP server development patterns.
